digest.component_or_area: snapshot store janitor and garbage collection
propositions: The ADR 0005-promised byte-total backstop trigger does not exist; _gc_pass reads only free disk space and mtime, never consulting the incrementally-maintained byte_total counter.
materialize_tickets populates entries into the store without calling add_bytes, leaving its ~620 MiB entries unaccounted and breaking the incremental byte total accounting invariant.
The snapshot store has no size-based reclaim mechanism armed, leaving disk pressure uncontained when the free-space watermark is unreachable and cold-trim exceeds the container lifetime.

A new configurable max_bytes cap (default off) must be implemented to gate eviction against the store's own byte total via a tunable resolved from REBAR_GATE_MAX_BYTES environment variable and [snapshot] config table.
materialize_tickets must call add_bytes on its won-race populate branch to make the incremental counter agree with the authoritative byte walk performed by startup_sweep.
